items.title: Space and Environment (khala aur mahol): introduction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to space and environment (PDF 169-170).

blocks.text: Space aur environment do aham fields hain jo aapas mein jure hue hain. In se hum universe (kainat) aur apni zameen dono ko samajhte hain. Space zameen ki atmosphere (hawa ki tah) se aage ka woh hissa hai jahan planets, stars aur galaxies jaisi tamam celestial bodies (aasmani cheezen) maujood hain. Yeh gravity aur electromagnetic radiation ke zariye aik doosre par asar dalti hain. Environment (mahol) woh physical, chemical aur biological halaat hain jin mein jandaar aur bejaan cheezen rehti hain aur aik doosre par asar karti hain. Is mein hawa, pani, zameen, climate (lambe arse ka mausam), ecosystems aur woh tamam natural processes (qudrati amal) shamil hain jo zameen par zindagi ko chalate hain. Is chapter mein hum dekhenge ke stars energy kaise emit karte hain (bahar nikalte hain) — isi ko luminosity kehte hain. Phir dekhenge ke cosmic faasle napne ke liye standard candles aur redshift jaise tools kaise kaam aate hain, aur radiation ke laws stars ka temperature aur size andaza lagane mein kaise madad dete hain. Hum yeh bhi seekhenge ke zameen ka climate system hawa, pani, barf, zameen aur zindagi ke aapas ke asar se kaise chalta hai, aur yeh sab Sooraj ki energy, hawa aur samandar ki circulation (gardish, ghoomna) se kaise badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Is chapter mein 'space' aur 'environment' mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Space zameen ki atmosphere se aage ka hissa hai jahan planets, stars aur galaxies gravity aur radiation se aik doosre par asar dalte hain. Environment zameen par woh physical, chemical aur biological halaat hain jin mein jandaar aur bejaan cheezen rehti hain (hawa, pani, zameen, climate).

items: Space: atmosphere se aage; stars, planets, galaxies.
Environment: zameen par hawa, pani, zameen, climate aur zindagi.
Chapter: stars ki luminosity, faasle, temperature aur size; phir zameen ka climate system.
